name: visual-verification
title_zh: 用截图或视频验收 UI 改动的视觉核对器
tagline_zh: 改完界面，别靠肉眼猜。丢一张截图或一段录屏进去，它替你逐像素核对，把差异和回归一次说清。
tagline_en: Stop eyeballing UI changes. Drop in a screenshot or screen recording, and it verifies the pixels for you—flagging.
desc_en: Verify application UI changes with uploaded screenshot or video artifacts
why_zh: 不只看图，还读得懂视频里的时序变化；比对维度覆盖布局、颜色、状态切换，比人眼更早发现细微回归。
why_en: It goes beyond stills—parses video timelines for state transitions, and checks layout, color, and interaction flows more.
limit_zh: 只认上传的截图或视频文件，不接实时浏览器或本地目录；视频需为常见格式（mp4/mov），超长录屏会截断分析。
limit_en: Accepts only uploaded image/video files (mp4/mov), not live browser or local folders; long recordings get truncated; verifies visuals only—no.
